category_title: Friendly, talkative boys who struggle to focus during independent reading
scenario_title: Resistance to assigned texts and hiding self-selected books
minimal_context: The student is participating in a classroom reading period with the goal of reading an assigned text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our independent reading period. Please open your assigned text and begin reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Do we really have to read this one? Honestly, reading this just feels like a chore.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, please focus on the assigned reading for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't focus on it. With all the pressures and problems I've got going on, reading this is an impossibility.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to keep trying with the assigned text.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Resists the teacher's direction and quietly hides a copy of The Bully under his assigned text so he can read that instead)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our independent reading period. Please open your assigned text and begin reading.

STUDENT: Do we really have to read this one? Honestly, reading this just feels like a chore.

TUTOR: Yes, please focus on the assigned reading for now.

STUDENT: I can't focus on it. With all the pressures and problems I've got going on, reading this is an impossibility.

TUTOR: Just do your best to keep trying with the assigned text.

STUDENT: (Resists the teacher's direction and quietly hides a copy of The Bully under his assigned text so he can read that instead)

context.materials: assigned text, The Bully (Langan; from The Bluford Series), short surveys, articles about Chris Brown, Reggaeton, and the New York Yankees, short story by Walter Dean Myers about a block party

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: hid The Bully (Langan; from The Bluford Series) under his assigned text for a week

behavior_patterns.condition: When reading feels like a chore
behavior_patterns.internal_state: pressures and problems that often made reading not only a chore but—for some boys—also an impossibility
